steps: Find a participating retailer on Energy Trust of Oregon's site.
Pick a selected qualifying washer, electric dryer, or heat-pump water heater model.
Buy it at that retailer — the $50 (washer/dryer) or $700 (heat-pump water heater) discount comes off at the register automatically.
No forms, no waiting — the savings are immediate.
timing: Instant — the discount is applied at the register at the participating retailer.
